act: AIFC Authorised Market Institution Rules (AMI), V11

en.title: AMI 2-1.2.2(4) refers to the annual audit 'required under AMI 2-1.5'; AMI has no 2-1.5 (audit is 2-1.4)
en.summary: AMI 2-1.2.2(4) requires systems and controls embedded in DLT to be "included within the scope of the annual audit and written report required under AMI 2-1.5". Chapter 2-1 (in AMI since V8, 1 January 2024) ends with 2-1.4 "Technology audit reports", which contains the annual audit and written report. In V8 to V11 there is no AMI 2-1.5.
en.correction: Please replace "AMI 2-1.5" with "AMI 2-1.4" in AMI 2-1.2.2(4). The description of the audit already fixes the meaning, so this is an editorial correction under section 19(3)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts.
